title: Lemniscate phase trajectories for high-fidelity GHZ state preparation in trapped-ion chains
summary: In trapped-ion chains, multipartite GHZ states can be prepared natively with the help of a single bichromatic laser pulse. However, higher-order terms in the expansion in the Lamb-Dicke parameter $η$ limit the GHZ state preparation infidelity for rectangular and bell-like pulses to the order of $η^4$. For tens of ions, the infidelity caused by out-of-Lamb-Dicke effects can reach several percents.
